title: Mall city connecter
content: I'm so glad I found this sub. I've had dreams many times about the mall city connecter. It connects two huge cities with a huge escalator that you trial on . I imagine it's about 500 miles long. I vividly remember looking out windows and seeing the desert night lit up with the moon. Stores of all kinds for 3 stories on each side of the two long moving walkways (like in the airport but bigger ). While your on the moving walkway there's beautiful viewing of the outside or tons of things going on in the 'mall' on the way there. Anyway yeah I love this sub.
